Overdose Warning for 5-MeO-MIPT
I recently was with a group in Mexico.  Gave 16 people a 6 mg dose of 5-meo-mipt.  This was procured from a high quality laboratory, and weighed with a high accuracy scale.
The first 4 people had an amazing experience, but at least 4 of the remaining 12 reacted very negatively. One woman was repeating am I dead or alive for a long time. Another man (150 lbs) was incapacitated.
But the biggest issue was with a woman (125 lbs) went into a horrible state of spasms. She was unable to communicate in any way, and was jerking to sit up and then would go back quickly.  She looked like she was in extreme anguish, possibly reliving traumas (just speculation, but thats how her face looked).
I have dealt with dozens of people on LSD or Mushrooms having bad trips, and usually you can have them lay down, start breathing and start doing some massage on their neck or feet and that will calm them and pull them into a much better place.  In this case none of this had any effect. It is not clear if she was able to understand anything.
Also because of her jerky movements, she became at severe risk for head injury. Luckily, I and other with with her and could prevent this, but had she been along, it could have been extremely dangerous. The day afterwards, it seems that no one had any lasting trauma, but this is hard to tell until time has passed.
Please be extremely careful with this drug and dosage. The same dosage affects people of the same bodyweight very differently.  You may have an amazing experience, but someone you take it with may be in a dangerous situation.
I would suggest never doing more than a small dose (maybe 3 mg - but thats just a guess) for the first time for anyone until you can determine the person's sensitivity to it.
It is possible that this laboratory makes high quality substance that is more potent than what others report, but that does not seem likely.  More likely is that there is just huge variation in sensitivity.
